description.value: Nimpo Lake Resort is a small, historic lakefront cabin resort on Nimpo Lake in BC's West Chilcotin, sitting directly on Highway 20 roughly midway between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. The property dates to the late 1960s and offers a mix of year-round and seasonal cabins ranging from a two-bedroom unit to a five-bedroom lodge. For cyclists riding the Highway 20 corridor, it is a natural overnight stop with lake access for paddling and fishing, and notably has invested in dedicated fiber-optic internet infrastructure.

address.value: 1595 Nimpo Creek Rd, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0
